caption: melancholic but warm indie pop with airy female vocal, mellow guitar, soft bass, relaxed beat, sparkly chimes, G major, 85 BPM
lyrics:
[verse]
Polar lights on quiet streets
Warm tea and the morning sheets
Photographs of brighter days
Love that never fades away

[chorus]
Stay with me a little more
Drift across the amber shore
Every word a silver line
In this slow and soft design

[verse]
Autumn letters on the door
Skipping stones across the floor
Lanterns swinging in the breeze
Sunlight dancing through the trees

[chorus]
Stay with me a little more
Drift across the amber shore
Every word a silver line
In this slow and soft design

[outro]
